_provenance.notes: Area M (Alaska Peninsula & Aleutian Islands) June commercial salmon fishery operates along South Unimak Island and the Shumagin Islands. Because salmon migrating to Bristol Bay, AYK, and Chignik pass through Area M coastal waters, this fishery has been one of Alaska's most intensely debated allocation fisheries for over 50 years. Downriver Alaska Native fishermen from the Yukon and Kuskokwim rivers have repeatedly petitioned the Board of Fisheries to restrict Area M June fishing hours during severe chum and Chinook salmon run failures.
